title: Unveiling gas production in rechargeable batteries via in situ differential electrochemical mass spectrometry
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00276A, Review Article
Guochuan Tang, Jiyu Zhang, Siyu Ma, Junyu Li, Zhangquan Peng, Weihua Chen
This review introduces the operating principles of in situ DEMS, alongside the generation mechanisms, evolution behavior, key influencing factors, and effective mitigation strategies for gases in batteries.
